sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a benefit of living together in a community?
options: B) We share our joys and sorrows
C) We never talk to each other
questions.answer: B) We share our joys and sorrows

questions.question_text: Which important neighbourhood service helps keep our surroundings safe from thieves?
What should you carry with you when going on a nature trail to note down what you see?
How do trees help our environment as we grow up with nature?
options: A) They make the air dirty
B) They give us fresh oxygen
questions.answer: B) They give us fresh oxygen

questions.question_text: Which of these is considered a healthy food choice for strong bones and teeth?

options: A) Someone who lives in another country
B) Someone who lives near our house
C) Someone we see on television
D) A wild animal in the jungle
questions.answer: B) Someone who lives near our house

questions.question_text: Where would you go in your neighbourhood to buy fresh fruits and vegetables?
When exploring a nature trail, what might you find under an old, damp log?
Which of these actions shows respect for nature?
options: B) Throwing garbage in a river
D) Plucking all the flowers in a garden

questions.question_text: Why do our bodies need energy-giving foods like rice and wheat?
options: B) To get strength to work and play
questions.answer: B) To get strength to work and play

questions.question_text: How do community helpers make our lives easier in a neighbourhood? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Community helpers like doctors, teachers, and sweepers provide essential services. They keep us healthy, educate us, and ensure our surroundings remain clean and safe.

questions.question_text: List two important places you can find in almost every neighbourhood and state their uses. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A hospital is used to treat sick people. A school is a place where children go to learn to read, write, and play together.

questions.question_text: Name two things you should avoid doing while walking on a nature trail. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: While on a nature trail, you should avoid making loud noises that scare birds and never leave plastic wrappers or garbage in the natural environment.

questions.question_text: Why is it important to plant more trees around our houses? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Planting trees is important because they give us clean air to breathe, provide cooling shade, and serve as safe homes for many small birds and animals.

questions.question_text: Explain the difference between junk food and healthy food with one example of each. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Healthy food like fresh apples gives our body energy and nutrients to grow. Junk food like potato chips tastes good but makes us lazy and unhealthy.

questions.question_text: Imagine a new family has moved into your neighbourhood. Describe three ways you would welcome them and help them settle in. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would visit them with my parents and offer a warm greeting with some homemade sweets. I would tell their children about the local park where we play and give them directions to the nearest grocery store and pharmacy.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are designing a healthy lunchbox for your school picnic. Describe the different food items you would pack and why. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would pack a vegetable sandwich made with brown bread for energy. I would include fresh carrot sticks and a juicy apple for essential vitamins. Lastly, I would bring a bottle of fresh lemon water to stay hydrated instead of sugary drinks.

questions.question_text: Explain how residents of a neighbourhood can work together to keep their community clean and peaceful. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Residents can form a community group to organize weekly cleanup drives and plant saplings in the local park. They should follow rules like throwing garbage only in closed bins, avoiding loud music late at night, and helping elderly neighbours, which creates a very clean, happy, and peaceful environment for everyone.

questions.question_text: Describe an interesting nature trail experience. What natural elements (plants, animals, sounds) would you observe, and how does it make you feel connected to nature? [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Walking along a forest trail, I would see tall green trees with sunlight peeking through the leaves. I would hear the sweet chirping of hidden birds and the crunch of dry leaves under my shoes. Spotting colorful butterflies and busy ants makes me feel amazed and deeply connected to our beautiful earth.
